AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

2. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Wild Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Wild Animals.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Wild Animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Wild Animals.

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Making Tacking Stitches? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Making Tacking Stitches.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Making Tacking Stitches.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Making Tacking Stitches.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Making Tacking Stitches.

7. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Conservation.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Water Conservation.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Conservation.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.

9. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Personal Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Personal Hygiene.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Personal Hygiene.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Personal Hygiene.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Personal Hygiene.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fuel Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fuel Conservation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fuel Conservation.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fuel Conservation.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fuel Conservation.

12. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only water vapour

13. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Fruits? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Fruits.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Fruits.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Fruits.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Fruits.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Balanced Meal? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Balanced Meal.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Balanced Meal.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Balanced Meal.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Balanced Meal.

16. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Decomposers only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Uses of Domestic Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Balanced Meal and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking Food food frying food and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Personal Hygiene and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Domestic Hygiene and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
